'''Reggok''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]], Reggok managed a small shop, selling valuable [[Plant/Legends|plants]] and medicines.
